title: SDP Authority Object
description: Represents a grant: a principal's authorization to make a bounded class of decisions. See SDP-0003.

constraints.description: Typed, decidability-classified bounds on the grant. Replaces the former free-text 'scope' array and untyped 'limits' object. Each item conforms to constraint.schema.json.

delegation_chain.description: Path by which authority reached the granting principal. Each registry-facing link MUST itself satisfy the registry-facing rule (SDP-0003 §7).

attestation.description: Signature(s) binding the grant to its issuer and, where applicable, the agent identity it authorizes. Cryptographic profile deferred to SDP-0007.

status.description: Current validity of the grant, resolvable at or after decision time.

resolver.description: How a verifier obtains current status (endpoint or short-lived signed status reference).

log_inclusion.description: Proof that this grant was recorded in a witnessing log before decisions made under it. A grant that is not logged is not valid. Profile deferred to SDP-0007.
